correctness.rationale: Every reversal-complete circular word has a cyclic 0^n factor. Rooting there is exhaustive. The exact suffix-mask/suffix-state recurrence counts all rooted completions and rules out every shorter length for n=1,2,3,4,5. An independently implemented direct factor-set enumeration confirms minimal lengths 2,4,8,14,26, necklace counts 1,1,2,8,128 and complement/reversal orbit counts 1,1,1,3,36; all optimal order-four and order-five cycles are listed. The published proofs describe the finite recurrence and its closure rule, including every boundary case. The two included checkers were executed successfully.

value.rationale: Exact shortest cyclic reversal covers are a natural length-limited universal-cycle invariant. Orders four and five are the first two nontrivial cases beyond the obstruction threshold in the classical unoriented de Bruijn problem, not arbitrary sliced parameters. Exact minima and complete classification of every minimizing rotation and symmetry orbit are mathematically informative boundary facts rather than isolated recomputation of a known table. No general all-order theorem is claimed or needed for this finite classification.
